name: Name
login.title: Sign in
login.nopassword: No password set yet. Set one on the server: vwitch admin passwd
login.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
egress.order.hint: Order is priority: clients use the topmost egress that works.
egress.order.weighted: Strategy “weighted”: clients are spread across working egresses by weight, each client sticks to its egress. Order does not matter here.
egress.weight.hint: Relative share of clients, e.g. 3 to 1.
egress.config.hint: Paste or upload the client config your router or server exported for this VPS.
client.expires.hint: Optional. Afterwards the client can no longer connect.
client.config.hint: Scan with the AmneziaWG app or import the file.
client.delete.confirm: Remove client %s? Its config stops working immediately.
settings.offline.hint: Block never leaks. Ask shows a page where clients may choose the direct egress.
settings.allow_direct: Allow the server's own connection as egress (direct)
settings.endpoint.hint: Used in client configs. Changing it requires new client configs.
settings.hostnames.hint: Clients open http://<first name>. Separate several names with commas.
settings.portal_actions: What clients may switch on their own page
settings.admin_interfaces: Interfaces allowed to reach this admin page
settings.lockdown_ssh: Allow SSH only on these interfaces (never awg0) once e.g. wt0 is up
settings.tls.hint: Applies immediately, no restart. The admin page always uses HTTPS. Put the chain (certificate + intermediates) into the certificate file.
portal.text.ok: Everything is fine. If the egress fails, vwitch switches automatically.
portal.text.fast: Faster, but websites see a data center address. Some services may ask for extra verification.
portal.text.direct: You are using the server's own connection. vwitch switches back as soon as a VPN egress returns.
portal.text.portal: The connection comes back automatically. Until then you can continue via the server directly.
portal.text.block: Your traffic is blocked so nothing leaks. It continues automatically when an egress is back.
portal.text.killswitch: The administrator has stopped all traffic.
portal.unknown: This device is not a known client.
portal.note.fast: For video and large downloads. Websites then see a data center address.
portal.note.direct: Websites see a data center address. Some services may reject logins or ask for extra checks.
settings.action.fast: Direct mode (straight via the server, faster)
settings.action.direct: Continue directly during an outage (after confirming)
settings.admin_interfaces.hint: Comma separated. Default: lo, awg0, so every VPN client reaches the admin page at https://v.witch. With NetBird, add wt0. Careful: removing the interface you are connected through locks you out.
settings.password.hint: At least 10 characters. Leave empty to keep it. Changing it signs out all sessions.
settings.tls.title: HTTPS certificate
settings.tls.remove.confirm: Remove your certificate? vwitch then uses a self-signed one again.
settings.tls.selfsigned.hint: vwitch generated this certificate. Browsers warn until you upload your own. Compare the SHA-256 fingerprint before accepting.
dash.killswitch.desc: Immediately blocks all client traffic. Nothing leaves the server until you turn it off.
dash.direct.desc: All clients use the server's own connection instead of an egress. Faster, but with the server's IP address.
client.route.hint: Automatic follows the strategy from the settings. If a fixed egress fails, “When no egress works” applies.
client.block.desc: Kill switch for this client only. Overrides the connection.
reason.client_block: Traffic is blocked for this client.
reason.direct_all: Direct mode for everyone is on.
reason.direct_client: This client goes direct via the server.
reason.failover: First working egress in the order.
reason.no_egress: No egress reachable, traffic is blocked.
reason.offline_direct: No egress reachable, traffic goes direct via the server.
reason.direct_confirmed: No egress reachable, the client confirmed going direct.
reason.asking: No egress reachable, asking the client.
sec.title: Security
sec.summary: Open ports and access to this server
sec.ports: These services are reachable from outside and do not belong to vwitch:
sec.ssh: SSH is reachable from the internet. Better: only via NetBird (or another overlay VPN) and enable “SSH only on these interfaces” in the settings.
sec.public_admin: The admin page is reachable via %s with a public IP. Remove that interface from the admin interfaces and use lo or an overlay VPN like NetBird (wt0).
sec.advice.firewall: Close everything you do not need with your provider's firewall or nftables/ufw. From outside, vwitch only needs UDP %s.
sec.advice.overlay: Make the admin page and SSH reachable only via an overlay VPN like NetBird: admin interfaces “lo, wt0” and “SSH only on these interfaces”.
sec.advice.cert: Install your own certificate or verify the SHA-256 fingerprint of the self-signed one.
issued.title: %s was created
issued.once: This configuration is shown only now. The private key is not stored. Scan the code or download the file now.
client.config.once: For security, the configuration is shown only when it is created; the private key is not stored. If it was lost or the server settings changed, create a new one.
client.renew.confirm: Create a new configuration for %s? The current one stops working immediately.
client.outdated: This client's configuration is outdated because server settings changed (e.g. address, port, MTU or obfuscation). Create a new one and import it on the device.
route.hint: Always send certain domains through a fixed egress, e.g. google.de via your home router. Subdomains are included. vwitch learns the addresses from the clients' DNS queries. If the egress is down, the normal exit applies; the kill switch and blocked clients always win. Browsers with their own DNS (Secure DNS/DoH) bypass the route.
route.domains.hint: One per line (or comma separated). Subdomains are included, URLs are cleaned up. Each domain may be in one route only.
settings.portal_actions.hint: Does not switch anything right away. Only sets which switches each client sees on its own page (http://v.witch). Direct mode switches appear only if the server's own connection is allowed.
settings.language.hint: For clients and browsers without their own choice. Switch the language of this page with DE/EN at the top.
settings.awg.strict.hint: Encrypts the packet headers and adds random trailers. Strongest camouflage, but every client on this ingress needs an app with AWG 3.1 and a new config.
settings.awg.strict.on.confirm: Switch on header protection? The clients of this ingress lose the connection until they import their new config, and clients without AWG 3.1 cannot connect at all.
settings.awg.strict.off.confirm: Switch off header protection? The clients of this ingress lose the connection until they import their new config.
client.awg3.hint: Adds the AWG 3.1 lines (random padding) to the config. Only for apps with AWG 3.1 support, older apps reject the config. Needs a new config.
client.awg3.strict: Its ingress uses header protection: this client always gets the AWG 3.1 config.
unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.text: You changed this page without saving. Save the changes before leaving?
block.regions.hint: Filters connections by the country an address is registered in.
block.countries.hint: Tap a country to remove it. Outgoing: connections clients start. Incoming: new connections to this server from outside, the VPN port included.
block.allow_incoming: “Allow only” for incoming connections also locks out SSH and the VPN from every other country, including yours when you travel.
block.geo.pending: The country database is loaded once region blocking is on.
block.domains.hint: Clients get no address for these domains and their subdomains. Tap a domain to remove it.
act.domains.off: The domain list is switched off.
settings.activity.hint: Keeps the domains clients looked up during the last 24 hours in memory (never on disk).
settings.listen_port.hint: Allow the new port in your provider's firewall first. Every client then needs a new config (marked as outdated).
ingress.hint: Clients connect to an ingress: an AmneziaWG interface with its own UDP port and camouflage. All ingresses share the client network, the server address and the server key, so a client can move between them.
ingress.port.hint: Allow this UDP port in your provider's firewall.
ingress.delete.used: Move its clients to another ingress first.
ingress.opt.strict.hint: Encrypts the packet headers and appends random bytes. Strongest camouflage, but only apps with AWG 3.1 can connect.
ingress.opt.isolated.hint: Its clients cannot reach other clients and cannot be reached by them. A new isolated ingress starts without admin UI access.
ingress.opt.new_clients_awg3.hint: New clients on this ingress get the AWG 3.1 config by default. Can still be turned off when adding a client or later per client.
ingress.opt.content_padding.hint: Data packets get a random length instead of a multiple of 16 bytes. Clients with AWG 3.1 also pad their own packets.
ingress.opt.disable_cookies.hint: Under load the server never sends WireGuard's recognizable cookie packets. Downside: less protection against handshake floods.
client.ingress.hint: The ingress decides the port and the camouflage of the config.
client.ingress.change: Changing the ingress needs a new config on the device.
client.pinned.hint: This client always uses %s. If it fails, “When no egress works” applies.
client.pinned.strategy.hint: This client has its own strategy instead of the one from the settings.
portal.text.paused: This device's traffic was paused, by you or by the administrator. Nothing leaves until it is resumed.
act.region_blocked.hint: Connections to its address in %s were blocked by the country filter.
ingress.opt.admin.hint: Its clients can open the admin UI at https://v.witch (still behind the login).
